Photorealistic wide horizontal view of the glass entrance of a modern Chinese shopping mall at night, shot straight-on at eye level, the glass doors filling the entire frame edge to edge with no pavement and no sky. Five tall glass door leaves with slim stainless-steel frames and long vertical handles, warm lobby beyond: polished cream stone floor with soft reflections, a low-lit service desk, potted plants, ceiling downlights and a hint of an escalator. All interior lighting is warm white and soft amber only; no green, cyan, magenta or coloured LED strips anywhere. Rain beads and cool street-light reflections on the glass. Realistic interior-exterior light ratio, warm versus cool contrast, sharp architectural detail, 35mm photograph, minimal perspective distortion, wide banner composition. No readable text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no people.
